title: langwhy facts: sourced data for a language, no prose
description: data/facts/<id>.yaml. Facts only: every value has a source URL and the date it was checked against that source. The pain, the trade-off and the users are verbatim quotes from the source, so no wording of ours goes in. Prose for the card is written later from these facts. A fact without a source stays out.

checked.description: When the fact was checked against its source.

quote.description: Copied word for word from the source; shortened only by cutting the start or the end. scripts/check-quotes.mjs --facts finds it on the page.

id.description: langwhy id, also the file name and /lang/<id>.

rank.description: PLDB rank when the file was made.

born_from.description: The pain it was built for, in the words of its creators or official history.

trades_away.description: What it gives up, as stated by its docs, creators or a first-hand source.

who.description: Name of the company, project or product.

card.description: Set when a card in data/languages already covers this language; born_from, trades_away and used_by then live in the card.
